title: Pure Zefra
summary: Pure Zefra Pendulum and omni-negate control strategy, uniting the chosen champions of Yang Zing, Shaddoll, Tellarknight, and Ritual Beast under the supreme Scale master Zefraath. The deck loops Zefraniu searches on Pendulum Summon to assemble multiple searchable Counter Traps.

summary.title: Starters
points: Oracle of Zefra adds any Zefra monster from your Deck to your hand upon activation, and triggers bonus effects on Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Summons.
Zefra Providence adds any Zefra card from your Deck to your hand, and banishes itself from the GY to protect your Zefra cards from destruction.
Zefraath places a Zefra Pendulum Monster from your Deck face-up into your Extra Deck and copies its Scale (Scale 1 or Scale 7), enabling full Pendulum Summons.
Terraforming searches Oracle of Zefra from your Deck.
Beyond the Pendulum searches any Pendulum Monster from Deck upon Link Summon and destroys 2 cards on the field when two monsters with different Levels are Pendulum Summoned.

summary.title: Opening: Zefraath + Providence + Zefraniu Loop
steps: Activate Zefra Providence to add Oracle of Zefra from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Oracle of Zefra to add Zefraath to your hand.
Place Zefraath in your Pendulum Zone; activate its effect to send Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing from Deck to your Extra Deck and copy its Scale 7.
Place another Zefra monster (such as Zefraxi, Treasure of the Yang Zing) in your other Pendulum Zone as Scale 1.
Pendulum Summon Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing from your face-up Extra Deck.
Zefraniu triggers on Pendulum Summon to add Zefra Divine Strike (or Nine Pillars of Yang Zing) from your Deck to your hand.
Set your Counter Traps, establishing layered spell, trap, and monster effect negations.

summary.title: The Core Zefra Tribes
points: Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing adds a Zefra or Yang Zing Spell/Trap from Deck to hand when Pendulum Summoned or when destroyed.
Zefraxi, Treasure of the Yang Zing treats a Zefra or Yang Zing monster as a Tuner when Pendulum Summoned or when destroyed.
Satellarknight Zefrabutha destroys a monster when Pendulum Summoned, and Stellarknight Zefraxciton destroys a Set card.
Ritual Beast Tamer Zefrawendi recovers a face-up Zefra from the Extra Deck, while Zeframpilica revives a Zefra from GY.
Zefranaga, Blazing Bold of the Shaddoll bounces a card to the hand when Pendulum Summoned.

summary.title: Bosses & Counter Traps
points: Denglong, First of the Yang Zing searches Nine Pillars of Yang Zing or Zefraniu on summon, modulates its Level, and floats into a Yang Zing when leaving the field.
Chaofeng, Phantom of the Yang Zing locks out opponent monster effects of matching original Attributes when Synchro Summoned using Zefraxi and Zefraniu.
Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing spins opponent cards into the Deck on summon and destroys Zefraniu to revive a monster, triggering Zefraniu's search.
Zefra Metaltron provides 3 downward Link Arrows and banishes Extra Deck monsters until the End Phase.
Zefra Divine Strike negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect by banishing a face-up Zefra monster from your Extra Deck.
Nine Pillars of Yang Zing negates any activation, shuffles the card into the Deck, and destroys a Yang Zing card you control (triggering Zefraniu).
Zefra War destroys a Zefra card you control and 1 card the opponent controls, and can be activated directly from hand while you have 2 Zefra cards in your Pendulum Zones.

main: Zefraath

Core Scale 5 Level 11 EARTH Rock Pendulum boss (3450 ATK): during your Main Phase in the Pendulum Zone, sends ANY 'Zefra' Pendulum Monster ('Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing' or 'Zefraxi, Treasure of the Yang Zing'!) directly from your Deck to your Extra Deck face-up, and if you do, changes this card's Pendulum Scale to that monster's Pendulum Scale (1 or 7) until the end of this turn!
Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing

Core Scale 7 Level 6 EARTH Wyrm Pendulum (0 ATK / 2600 DEF): when Pendulum Summoned, OR when destroyed by battle or card effect in your Monster Zone (such as by Nine Pillars of Yang Zing or Zefra War!), adds ANY 'Zefra' Spell/Trap OR 'Yang Zing' Spell/Trap ('Zefra Divine Strike', 'Nine Pillars of Yang Zing', 'Zefra Providence', or 'Zefra War'!) from your Deck to your hand!
Zefraxi, Treasure of the Yang Zing

Core Scale 1 Level 3 EARTH Wyrm Pendulum: if this card is Pendulum Summoned, or Special Summoned from the Main Deck, targets 1 'Yang Zing' or 'Zefra' monster you control (except itself) and treats it as a Tuner this turn—allowing you to Synchro Summon Denglong, Yazi, Baxia, or Chaofeng using any two Zefra monsters!
Satellarknight Zefrathuban

Scale 1 Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Pendulum: when Normal, Flip, or Pendulum Summoned, targets 1 other 'Zefra' card in your Monster Zone or Pendulum Zone and 1 face-up card your opponent controls, and destroys them!
Stellarknight Zefraxciton

Scale 7 Level 4 LIGHT Fiend Pendulum (1900 ATK): when Normal, Flip, or Pendulum Summoned, targets 1 other 'Zefra' card in your Monster Zone or Pendulum Zone and 1 Set card your opponent controls, and destroys them!
Ritual Beast Tamer Zeframpilica
Scale 1 Level 3 WIND Psychic Pendulum: when Normal or Pendulum Summoned, targets 1 'Ritual Beast' or 'Zefra' monster in your GY and Special Summons it!
Shaddoll Zefranaga

Scale 1 Level 2 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum: when Pendulum Summoned or sent to the GY, targets 1 card in either player's Pendulum Zone and returns it to the hand; pairs as a Level 2 with Level 3 Tuner-treated Zefraxi to Synchro Summon Level 5 Denglong!
Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing
Level 1 LIGHT Wyrm Tuner sent to GY or summoned from Deck by Denglong, First of the Yang Zing.
Suanni, Fire of the Yang Zing
Level 4 FIRE Wyrm summoned from Deck when Nine Pillars of Yang Zing destroys Zefraniu on your field.
Zefra Providence

Core Normal Spell: adds ANY 'Zefra' card (except itself—searching Zefraath, Oracle of Zefra, Zefraniu, or Zefra Divine Strike!) from your Deck to your hand; and if a 'Zefra' card(s) you control would be destroyed, you can banish this card from your GY instead!
Oracle of Zefra

Core Field Spell: when activated, adds ANY 'Zefra' monster from your Deck to your hand; and when you Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Summon using a 'Zefra' monster as material, activates a bonus effect (Synchro: places any monster from your Deck on top of your Deck; Xyz: draws 1 card and discards 1 card)!
Zefra Path
Continuous Spell: while you have 2 'Zefra' cards in your Pendulum Zones with Scales 1 and 7, neither player can Special Summon monsters, except from the hand or Extra Deck!
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Oracle of Zefra.
Zefra Divine Strike

Signature Counter Trap (searchable by Zefraniu and Zefra Providence!): when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated, banishes 1 face-up 'Zefra' monster from your Extra Deck to negate the activation and destroy it!
Nine Pillars of Yang Zing

Signature Counter Trap (searchable by BOTH Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing AND Denglong, First of the Yang Zing!): when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a 'Yang Zing' card (Zefraniu, Zefraxi, or Denglong!), negates the activation, shuffles that card into the Deck, and destroys 1 Yang Zing card you control (destroying Zefraniu in your Monster Zone to trigger Zefraniu's search on the opponent's turn!)!
Zefra War

Signature Normal Trap (searchable by Zefraniu and Zefra Providence!): targets 1 other 'Zefra' card you control and 1 card your opponent controls and destroys them; if you have 2 'Zefra' cards in your Pendulum Zones, you can activate this card directly from your HAND!
extra: Denglong, First of the Yang Zing

Limited to 1 in TCG: Level 5 LIGHT Wyrm Synchro Tuner (Level 3 Zefraxi + Level 2 Zefranaga): adds ANY 'Yang Zing' card ('Nine Pillars of Yang Zing' or 'Zefraniu'!) from your Deck to your hand on Special Summon, sends a Wyrm from Deck to GY to copy its Level, and Special Summons a Yang Zing from your Deck when leaving the field!
Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing

Level 8 LIGHT Wyrm Synchro boss: shuffles cards on the field into the Deck on Synchro Summon up to the number of different original Attributes of the Wyrm materials used, and destroys 1 card you control (Zefraniu!) to revive a Level 4 or lower monster from your GY!
Yazi, Evil of the Yang Zing

Level 7 DARK Wyrm Synchro: cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, destroys 1 Yang Zing you control (Zefraniu!) and 1 card your opponent controls, and summons a Wyrm from your Deck if destroyed.
Chaofeng, Phantom of the Yang Zing

Level 9 LIGHT Wyrm Synchro boss (Level 3 Zefraxi + Level 6 Zefraniu—both EARTH Wyrms!): while this Synchro Summoned card is on the field, your opponent cannot activate effects of monsters with the same original Attribute(s) as the 'Yang Zing' monsters used for its Synchro Summon (locking out all EARTH monster effects when made with Zefraxi + Zefraniu!)!

Signature Link-3 LIGHT Wyrm (2+ monsters Summoned from the Extra Deck): gains 3 downward Link Arrows for Pendulum Summoning, and banishes 1 monster you control + 1 monster your opponent controls summoned from the Extra Deck until the End Phase!
Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Zefraath or Zefraniu before you Pendulum Summon and pops 2 cards on the field.
Link-3 Pendulum monster that recovers a face-up Zefra from your Extra Deck and Special Summons a Zefra during the Main Phase.
